title: Governed dispatch policy artifact
description: Closed, total schema for docs/model-economy/governed-dispatch-policy.json — the single machine-authoritative source for the governed-dispatch semantic data (pinned request schema id, model tier order, committed task-class taxonomy, Opus-insufficiency denylist). additionalProperties:false at every level; every array uniqueItems and non-empty. The validator proves the policy artifact against this schema before trusting any datum in it, exactly as it proves the request against the request schema — no untyped policy value, no unadmitted key.
